summary: Global Water Resources, Inc. filed an 8-K regarding a routine seventh amendment to its existing revolving credit facility with The Northern Trust Company. The amendment extends the maturity date from May 18, 2027 to May 18, 2028, but does not change the $20 million borrowing limit or involve any special-situation event such as an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, or capital return. The filing contains only ordinary credit facility modifications, customary representations, and financial exhibits. This is a routine current report with no special-situation implications.
